content.short: Super DCA automates dollar-cost averaging onchain, splitting purchases into regular buys over time.
content.description: Super DCA automates dollar-cost averaging on-chain: a user sets an amount and a schedule, and purchases are executed in regular increments instead of one lump sum. Streaming the buys reduces exposure to a single bad entry price. It is deployed on Unichain.
content.meta: Super DCA automates onchain dollar-cost averaging with scheduled purchases, deployed on Unichain.
